messages.text: {crew}. Two regions. Down here that makes you a target, not a guest.
Every crew in the South has your tape. First rung is Memphis. Saturday. Hydrate.
let 'em watch
WE GOT RECOGNIZED AT A GAS STATION IN TENNESSEE 😭😭 the cashier knew KEYS
she said I "look like my stats." I've been thinking about it for 200 miles
AC is still the heater knob. Windows down. That's the AC now.
wearing the Chicago coat. it's 94 degrees. I paid for it. it's getting worn
Heat is honest, youngin. It shows who trained.
Memphis first. hydrate
{crew}!!! TWO REGIONS?!?! MEMPHIS BEEN WAITING ALL SUMMER!!!
GRIND MODE!!! WE DON'T STOP!!! WE RUN TILL THE STREETLIGHTS QUIT!!!
BRING Y'ALL'S LOUDEST GUY!!! I WANNA MEET HIM!!!
he's on his way
HE WANTS ME?? HE GOT ME 😤📢 FIRST ONE TO TYPE LOWERCASE LOSES
Big Crunk texts louder than Dre. I didn't know that was allowed
Hustlers are last on the ladder. but Grind Mode means they never stop running. never
Two coolers. One is water. The other one is also water.
Memphis grinds, youngin. Out-grind 'em. Then rest.
WE OUT-CRUNKED BIG CRUNK 📢🔥🔥
Dre lost his voice in the 6th. we scored four runs in the quiet. just saying
I CAN STILL TYPE KEYS
Twinkie Toes stole three bases on us. Then hugged everybody. Memphis is nice.
Grind's over. Atlanta's next. Atlanta thinks.
one down. ATL
GRIND MODE!!! MEMPHIS DON'T STOP!!! Y'ALL DID THO 😂
he out-louded me. I'm typing lowercase in shame
caps back on. run it back
SORRY. all caps is a team rule. I'm practicing lowercase. it feels weird
y'all won QUIET. didn't know you could win quiet
what you bring?
Grind. I'll run the last lap nobody wants. Every time.
Room for some Memphis on {crew}?
The Prophet saw {crew} coming. Saw it last spring. Saw the ending too.
Won't spoil it. Just know: get comfy on second, the TRAP DOOR opens.
Atlanta don't chase you. We wait.
what else you see?
I see 285 traffic making y'all late. Leave early. 🔮
He's right about 285. We leave at 5.
Bankhead Bunni's pitch drops off a table. watched 40 clips. still can't see it
LEMON PEPPER WINGS AFTER?? 🍗🍋
Win first. Wings are a reward food. Like the ravioli.
Prophets talk a lot about the future, youngin. Play the present.
THE PROPHET DID NOT SEE THAT COMING 🔮😂
nobody fell through the Trap Door. we just didn't stand on second. simple
I'm calling it the Keys Doctrine
Lemon Pepper Lia picked the wing spot. Rival or not, she was right.
10K FOLLOWERS 🎉 WE'RE VERIFIED IN MY HEART
Two down in the South. Next crew brings a band.
New Orleans
Told you. Saw it in the spring. 🔮 The Trap Door don't miss.
we KNEW about second. we stood on second anyway
run it back. stay off second
Prophet said I'd text y'all tonight. I said no way. And here I am.
y'all don't fall for traps. that's rare down here
what's your game?
Zone Six speed. I steal second and I don't sit on it.
Prophet says I'm wearing {crew} colors next. Should I believe him?
Where y'at, {crew}! Come hungry. We feed company first.
Then the band plays. Then the DEATH ROLL. Then we feed y'all again.
we'll stay for dessert
Baby, dessert is the second line we walk after we win. 🎺
THEY GOT A BRASS BAND?? AT KICKBALL?? 🎺🎺
their catcher threw out 14 runners this year. her name is Treme Tasha
There's one Tasha in this game.
there are literally two
There's ONE Tasha in this game, Keys.
Eat what they give you, youngin. Then go to work.
WE BEAT A WHOLE BRASS BAND 🎺😂 THE TUBA GUY CLAPPED FOR US
One Tasha. I stole third on her twice.
she threw two of us out tho. Tasha series is tied 2-2
One Tasha, Keys.
They second-lined us off the court anyway. That's New Orleans, youngins.
three down. Houston
Death Roll, baby. 🐊 Stay for gumbo, {crew}. You earned the gumbo.
Fine. There were two Tashas today.
rematch. one Tasha
Chief says if you can't dance at the plate, you can't kick. I can't dance.
But I can KICK. And y'all don't dance either and you win.
how far you kick?
Over the levee in practice. Chief made me apologize to a pelican.
So. Got room on {crew} for somebody who can't dance?
yoooo... {crew}...
Houston... we take it... sloooow...
y'all been... moving real fast... all summer...
COIL STRIKE.
that one was fast
...yeah... that's the point... 🐍
Rattlers look slow. they are not. 21-2. both losses in the rain
i tried texting slow back... i... CAN'T 😭😭 MY THUMBS WON'T LET ME
It's 101 in Houston. Windows down. The AC is still the heater knob.
Slow is smooth, youngin. Smooth is a strike. Watch for the rattle.
WE SNATCHED THE RATTLE 🐍😂 FOUR DOWN
Slab King takes 9 seconds to pitch. we stole on all of them. I timed it
Candy Paint Cruz said our grounders were "too fast to be legal." Compliment.
Stayed cool in 101, youngins. That's the work.
MIAMI NEXT. LAST ONE ON THE LADDER 🌴🔥
four down
slooow... wins... the race... {crew}... 🐍
we lost to a man who texts three words a minute
run it back
yo... sorry. habit. Okay. Typing normal. That's hard for us.
Y'all play fast. I've played slow so long my legs forgot they could.
you still fast?
Fastest on the Rattlers. Slim makes me walk to first. WALK.
Room on {crew} for somebody who wants to run?
Oye, {crew}. Heard you're cold-weather champs. Cute. It's 98 in the shade.
HEAT INDEX: the longer the game goes, the hotter we play.
By the 7th y'all melting. Cafecito's on me after. Dale. ☀️
we'll take the cafecito. after
Heatwave haven't lost after the 5th inning all year. all year. I checked twice
LAST RUNG. THEN THE BRACKET. THEN THREE REGIONS 😤🌴
Ice in both coolers. Towels in the trunk. Keys, lose the coat.
the coat stays. I paid for it
Heat don't care, youngin. Neither should you.
WE BEAT THE HEAT 🌴🔥 LADDER DONE!!! THREE LADDERS!!!
won it in the 9th. after the 5th. first time all year. framing the box score
Cafecito Kid bought us all cafecito. It's tiny. It's strong. Dre is vibrating.
I CAN SEE SOUNDS
Ladder's done, youngins. Bracket's where it gets hot for real.
ladder done
Heat Index, baby. 🌡️ Told you the 7th was ours. Cafecito's still on me.
Next time twice the ice.
run it back
Capo can't know about this. He'd talk about it in two languages. For a week.
Y'all didn't melt. NOBODY doesn't melt down here.
what you bring?
Hurricane arm. Hialeah grown. I've thrown runners out from the wall.
Dale. Got room for me on {crew}?
{crew}. One seed. This spring y'all were a rumor.
Semi Saturday vs Houston. Final Sunday. Nationals scouts in the stands. Both days.
Clean shoes. It's hot. I still check.
we'll be there
NATIONALS SCOUTS?!? ARE WE GONNA BE ON TV?? 📺😭
one seed means everybody's aiming at us. a third of one seeds lose the semi. I looked
Lou wants clean shoes. Keys. And lose the coat.
the coat stays
'98 we were a four seed. Y'all already doing better than us, youngins.
6am. windows down
yoooo... rematch... {crew}...
we been... practicing... FAST.
...just playing... 🐍
take your time
Rattlers 6-0 since we beat them. Slab King pitches in 6 seconds now. six
THAT'S STILL SLOW KEYS
for HIM that's a sprint
Snakes strike when you look away, youngin. Don't look away.
SOUTH FINAL BABY 🏆 SNAKE'S IN THE BAG
a scout wrote something down when I caught that liner. I need to know what
Slim said "good game" at normal speed. Felt like a trophy.
Miami tomorrow, youngins. Hot crew, hot day. Stay cool.
Miami. let's go
slow... and steady... {crew}... 🐍
Lou says re-entry's open. Windows still down.
then we're still in it
Told you we'd get to the 9th together, {crew}. Now it's hot for real.
Win, you're three regions deep. Lose, you still get cafecito. Miami's generous.
we'll take both
Youngins. Phones down after this.
'98, we never got out of one region. Y'all about to have three.
Heatwave are 26-1 at home. the 1 was us. so it's 50/50. I'm calling it 50/50
I'M SWEATING AND IT'S NOT EVEN THE HEAT 😭🔥
Ice. Towels. Pops' chair. Keys' coat, apparently. Let's go.
the coat stays
south final. let's eat
SOUTH CHAMPS!!!!! THREE REGIONS!!!!! THREE!!!!! 🏆🏆🏆👑
...give me a minute.
KEYS IS CRYING 😭😭
It's pollen.
Keys. You said there's no pollen.
in Cleveland. this is Miami. Miami has pollen. I've updated my numbers
Three trophies. One cupholder. Proudest storage problem I ever had.
two to go
Heat Index. 🌡️ Cafecito's on me, {crew}. Come back hotter.
Hot one, youngin. Bracket's still open. We go again.
again
Lou emailed. Southwest ladder: Gilas, Dallas, Vegas, Denver, Albuquerque.
Denver's a mile up. the ball flies farther. so do our mistakes
50K FOLLOWERS 😭 a kid in Miami got our logo SHAVED into his head
Sister Ruth wants one.
Car's at 211,000 miles. AC's still the heater knob. She'll make it. She has to.
Three regions, youngins. The bus never got out of one. Keep driving.
desert next
Dale. Go take the desert. Miami's coming to Nationals too. ☀️
Philly, Cleveland, now us. Y'all collecting enemies. 😎
I mean friends. Mostly enemies.
